title: Anglo-Spanish War (1762–1763)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Spanish War (1762–1763)", at revision 1370428618, opens: "The Anglo-Spanish War was fought between Britain and Spain as part of the Seven Years' War. It lasted from January 1762 until February 1763, when the Treaty of Paris brought it to an end." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q616846, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1762–1763 war between Britain and Spain as part of the Seven Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
